I help you believe in yourself and your potential. By showing exercises to overcome your fears and doubts. We will discuss your achievements and how to explain them in an organized manner.

Behavioral Interview Questions 
Behavioral interview questions delve into how candidates handled past situations to learn about their ability to perform in a position. 
These are the type of questions that start with something like, "Give me an example of..." or "Tell me about a time...." or “Describe an occasion when….” or “Outline a situation….” A popular behavioral question is, “Give me an example of when you had to deal with a difficult customer.” .

The STAR Method
The STAR interview method is a technique you can use to prepare for behavioral and situational interview questions. STAR stands for: situation, task, action and result. This method will help you prepare clear and concise responses using real-life examples.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Class
pro_course_detail.description:
With this simple course, advanced students can expect to make regular strides in terms of conversational competence and confidence. I will generally not prepare any materials for the class. This approach will challenge students to think, speak and comprehend quickly in order to match the pace of native-level verbal communication.  

Unless a student prefers to review mistakes at the end, I will make a note of all errors made by the student and corrections will be made during conversation at appropriate moments; if necessary, further teaching and practice will be provided to address significant or recurring errors. Lastly, please note that, for the sake of verisimilitude, there will be no set topic or lesson materials provided and no homework assigned. However, if a student wishes to propose conversation topics prior to the class, this will be encouraged.

pro_course_detail.title: Standard Native English Course
pro_course_detail.description:
This course features an approach developed by the teacher over the course of several years’ teaching experience. I will tailor materials to meet individual students' needs while keeping in mind the four fundamental skills: speaking, listening, reading, and writing.

Class time will predominantly be dedicated to speaking and listening (with particular attention devoted to improving pronunciation, intonation and comprehension/thinking/speaking speed). I will carefully select course material prior to each class, including grammar exercises, written dialogues, news articles and YouTube videos, in order to offer students only the most important and practical knowledge for speaking REAL English for work and general communication with NATIVE English speakers. Therefore, students will spend less time learning vocabulary out of context; instead, tricky yet essential aspects of English such as idioms and phrasal verbs, presented in context, will form the basis of a student’s learning.

pro_course_detail.title: Academic Writing (with Revision)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course, we will work together to improve your academic writing. This is my specialty and I have tutored many students in this area, helping them successfully prepare application essays, dissertations, and more.

First, we will work on structure for academic essays and formal argumentative style. If you are more experienced, we will work to fine-tune your abilities according to your precise needs and upcoming projects. I am also happy to dedicate classes to specific skills such as assembling a literature review or effectively addressing counter-arguments within your essays. In principle, I am happy and comfortable working on any type of writing, from CVs and emails to dissertations, college applications and even fiction. Finally, included in the price of each lesson, I will proofread and edit up to 500 words of your writing per class and give you detailed comments and feedback.

pro_course_detail.title: Casual Conversation Class (No Video)
pro_course_detail.description: Offered for the purpose of allowing both student and teacher greater flexibility, this no-frills lesson type gives you the opportunity to practice speaking on the go, wherever you are, as long as you have access to a stable internet connection. Though correcting your mistakes will, of course, remain a top priority in this class, the approach will generally be much more casual. Therefore, I would only recommend this option to upper-intermediate and advanced students looking to increase their speaking practice time with a CELTA-qualified teacher. Ideally, the casual conversation class will resemble a spontaneous phone call between friends. To facilitate this and enhance flexibility, please note that video will not be used.

course_info.trial_description:

This is because it is impossible to forget our mother language. With this idea in mind, it is better to think of it as adding another accent into your arsenal. This way, you will be able to utilize the accent according to the language.

Speaking: Oftentimes when having a conversation with someone we do not think about our pronunciation. It is good to not think too much about it, but it is even better if one does not need to think about it while at the same time have great pronunciation. The way a native speaker speaks is not the it is written.

Reading: When reading aloud in English, we have certain rhythms and pauses that occur. We also connect words and drop sounds. Each language has their own unique cadence, and here we will attempt accustom your to English.

Welcome to the Pronunciation & Accent Training ESL English program! As an experienced language instructor, I am dedicated to helping you develop clear and confident English pronunciation, and to refine your accent to effectively communicate in any English-speaking setting.
In this specialized course, we will focus on several key areas to enhance your pronunciation and accent:
Phonetics & Sounds: We will explore the different sounds present in the English language, paying particular attention to those that may not exist in your native language. Through interactive exercises and drills, you will learn to produce these sounds accurately.
Word Stress & Intonation: Understanding word stress and intonation patterns is essential for natural and expressive speech. You will master the rhythm and melody of English, making your speech more engaging and easy to understand.
Vowel & Consonant Sounds: We will dive deep into English vowel and consonant sounds, addressing common challenges and helping you articulate them with precision.
Reduced Speech & Linking: English speakers often link words together and use reduced speech in everyday conversation. You will learn these techniques to sound more like a native speaker and improve your listening comprehension.
Accents & Regional Variations: While achieving a neutral accent is the primary goal, we also embrace and appreciate various English accents and regional variations. You will gain exposure to different accents, helping you adapt to diverse English-speaking environments.
Remember, perfect pronunciation is not the goal. Our aim is to help you communicate clearly and confidently, embracing your unique voice while developing a solid foundation in English pronunciation!

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking and Preperation Class (adults and children)
pro_course_detail.description:
Become confident in English!
In this class, I will guide you through a conversation by using material to read and discuss. Or we can prepare for an interview or an exam. You will achieve the skills you need to speak fluently with other English speakers. This class is tailored to you, your level, background, interests, and culture.

I have helped my students with:
- preparing for interviews
- gaining the fluency to talk to colleagues/clients or neighbors/locals
- their studies and homework in English (review what you took in class with me)
- simply practicing their skills and catching any mistakes they might have

You are welcome to bring any article, YouTube video, book, or life story to the conversation. 

You may ask me to explain a word or grammar structure, and I’ll be sure to include it in our conversation.
If you would like, I can include a writing assignment for you to complete and send to me before our next lesson, and I will send the corrections to you before our next class.

pro_course_detail.title: Reading Together (adults and children)
pro_course_detail.description:

For this class, we can agree on a book or article to read together.
I will screen-share the pages, or we will both hold a physical copy of the book. We will take turns reading one page at a time. This way, you can passively learn sentence structure and vocabulary, and you will learn correct pronunciations through my corrections and by listening to me read.
Of course, we will discuss the book and ask each other questions :)
* For professional men, I will not turn my camera on. I will share my screen instead.

pro_course_detail.title: Editing Writing Class
pro_course_detail.description:

In this class, it’s not just about editing. We will talk about how and why we are changing your text, and this will give you the tools to become a better writer yourself.

* This class needs to be on Zoom, Skype, Google Meets, or VooV so we can easily share our screens.
